rules.original_retained_strings: exact CSV tokens; no numeric conversion
rules.omitted_fields: listed separately for every projected file in RECOVERY_RECORD.json
rules.groups: only exact original-value matches to existing r4 anchors; no new chemical grouping
rules.unresolved: empty anchor plus group_mapping_unresolved; cannot support claims requiring that grouping until restored
rules.empty_original: empty anchor plus source_empty; do not conflate with unresolved
rules.recovery_source_row: one-based source row address, never a replacement scientific ID
rules.structures: structure strings are omitted; this does not reconstruct or independently verify structures

source_specific_conditions: Retained labels, outcomes and derived values keep their upstream conditions. A projection does not establish redistribution permission.
